scope.review_type: targeted causal path and scientific contract; not whole-project certification

findings.title: Genome target applied to global while local instance decides
findings.evidence: Base lib.rs:3539 and local queries following; local stays 0.10 at gene 0.03.
findings.change: Select local/fallback once and apply target to that instance; preserve adapted state.

findings.title: Effective-alpha telemetry taken from a different instance
findings.change: Publish effective_alpha from selected calibrator at lib.rs:3318.
findings.remaining: Legacy global registry remains last-writer; external unscoped consumers not certified.

findings.title: Invalid predictions imputed/clipped into observations and admitted in warmup
findings.evidence: 40->45 observations, alpha 0.105->0.0875 after five invalid values.
findings.change: Reject nonfinite/out-of-range before mutation; accepts=false; p-value API=0 explicit invalid sentinel, not inferred rank.

findings.title: Entry interlock bypassed conformal publication
findings.evidence: Base entries_blocked return precedes conformal block.
findings.change: Publish after ml_prob_motor before entry interlock; entry veto and close return unchanged.
findings.remaining: Does not move all downstream analytics or kill switch.

findings.title: Unprojected ACI tracking bound claimed for clipped recurrence
findings.evidence: 5000 tied scores: 4970 updates, alpha_eff=0.5, observed_error=0, target=0.1, original_bound~=0.03642.
findings.remaining: Numerical policy unchanged; example establishes overcoverage/tracking failure, not undercoverage.
findings.acceptance: Specify projection residual, target schedule, outcome chronology and prove or empirically qualify the actual contract.

findings.title: Marginal coverage is not selected-trade loss control
findings.evidence: Singleton acceptance conditions on a selected subset; a marginal bound alone only gives alpha/P(selection).
findings.acceptance: Record selection and decision-time sets, measure selective risk; validate any online selective procedure assumptions.

findings.title: Outcome-time recalculation differs from decision-time set
findings.evidence: update accepts only (p_hat, won); no snapshot, times or version; close loop at lib.rs:2578.
findings.acceptance: Causal prediction ledger with decision set, version, delay and replay of out-of-order outcomes.

findings.title: Directional probability and net-PnL labels are not equivalent
findings.evidence: Complement by side is trained against net outcome; stop/cost/first-touch semantics differ.
findings.acceptance: Align model target and economic outcome by side/asset/tau/costs with OOS validation.

findings.title: Per-asset scalar window mixes ages, scales and versions
findings.evidence: VecDeque<f64>, n=200, no timestamp/tau/version in update.
findings.acceptance: Provenance first; compare partial pooling and continuous conditioning without assuming weighted conformal validity.
findings.unverified_hypothesis: Index identity under universe rotation requires separate replay.

findings.title: Finite rank resolution can make every singleton infeasible
findings.evidence: target .01, 200 wins then scores .2/.3/.4: alpha .00365 < 1/201; no valid probability can exclude loss.
findings.remaining: Whole-engine starvation not proved: other strategies may supply feedback.
findings.acceptance: Instrument no-support state and design safe shadow-outcome protocol; do not remove risk gates merely to force trades.

findings.title: Warmup and missing-key fail-open conflate no evidence and admissibility
findings.evidence: min_calibration=30, p=1, accepts=true for valid inputs; zero errors with zero steps; filter missing key=>true.
findings.acceptance: Explicit calibration quality/coverage state and empirical startup policy.

findings.title: Valid p=0 filtered by outcome caller
findings.evidence: lib.rs:2578 uses ml_at_entry > 0 while calibrator supports endpoints.
findings.acceptance: Disambiguate missing predictor from legitimate zero before changing caller guard.

findings.title: Repeated rank scans on hot path
findings.evidence: Two published p-values plus two accepts: up to six*n comparisons/event, n<=200.
findings.not_claimed: No p99 regression or HFT latency benchmark measured.
findings.acceptance: Shared-rank equivalence including ties plus isolated benchmark; quantify added work on blocked-entry events.

findings.title: One gene controls conformal adaptation and normal significance
findings.evidence: filter significance_strength uses conformal_alpha and two_sided_normal_p(z).
findings.acceptance: Joint/ablation OOS evaluation and null-distribution checks; not a claim that normal formula itself is wrong.

integration.verification: Pending remote PR receipt; pre-merge tests are not proof of remote publication.
